message.reasoning_content: JFK assassination Nov 22, 1963. With the Beatles released Nov 22, 1963, containing "Not a Second Time" and "Anna". Both on same album, released same day. Which is "first released" in November 1963? Both. Hmm—"Anna (Go to Him)"... both. Pick "Not a Second Time"? Or "Anna" was also on the album. Both same. Maybe "I Forgot to Remember to Forget" was a hit in the US around then... Actually the song is known for reaching #1 on Billboard in 1960. The Beatles' version... The assassination is Nov 1963; With the Beatles Nov 22. Pick one—probably "Not a Second Time"? I'll go "Anna (Go to Him)". Hmm, ambiguous. Choose "Not a Second Time" with low probability.
